ex: 政府发布了新法令。
The government issued a new decree.
这项法令下个月开始实行。
This decree takes effect next month.
use: Formal; measure word 项 or 条.

ex: 这家公司福利很好。
This company has good benefits.
员工福利包括免费午餐和体检。
Staff benefits include free lunch and health check-ups.
use: 福利院 = children's home or care home.

m: **Know** things apart (**leave** them separate): to **identify**, to **tell apart**.
ex: 这个软件能识别人脸。
This software can recognise faces.
我们要学会识别假钱。
We need to learn to spot fake money.
use: 识别能力 = ability to recognise. Tech: 语音识别 (speech recognition).

m: **Draw** it in to **enter**: to **introduce**, to **bring in**.
ex: 公司引入了新技术。
The company brought in new technology.
这个城市引入了很多外国投资。
This city has attracted a lot of foreign investment.
use: Formal; for ideas, technology, capital. Compare 引进.

ex: 他被坏人杀害了。
He was murdered by criminals.
警察正在调查记者被杀害的案子。
The police are investigating the murder of the journalist.
use: Usually passive: 被杀害. Stronger, more formal than 杀.

m: A **person** who **grinds** away to get **after all** the facts: a **researcher**.
ex: 她是一名研究员。
She is a researcher.
研究所里有五十多位研究员。
There are over fifty researchers at the institute.
use: Also a senior research rank, like professor.

ex: 这种药能缓解头疼。
This medicine can relieve headaches.
新地铁缓解了交通压力。
The new subway line has eased traffic pressure.
use: Objects: 压力, 疼痛, 紧张, 交通.

ex: 门铃响起来了。
The doorbell rang.
音乐响起，大家开始跳舞。
The music started and everyone began to dance.
use: Also 响起来. Subject is the sound or its source.

ex: 他每天写工作日志。
He writes a work log every day.
系统日志里记录了这个错误。
This error was recorded in the system log.
use: Computing: log file. 日记 is a personal diary.

m: Set a **policy** and **mark out** the steps: to **plan**, to **organise**.
ex: 这次活动是她策划的。
She planned this event.
他在一家广告公司做策划。
He works as a planner at an ad agency.
use: Neutral in business; sometimes negative: 策划阴谋 (plot).

ex: 青蛙能在陆地上生活。
Frogs can live on land.
地球上海洋比陆地大得多。
On earth the oceans are much bigger than the land.
use: Opposite: 海洋.

m: Belong to a **category** like a **servant**: to **be under** (an authority).
ex: 这个部门隶属于教育部。
This department is under the Ministry of Education.
这所医院隶属于北京大学。
This hospital is affiliated with Peking University.
use: Formal; usually 隶属于.

ex: 我小时候想当飞行员。
As a child I wanted to be a pilot.
这位飞行员已经飞了二十年。
This pilot has been flying for twenty years.
use: Measure word 名 or 位.

ex: 这个国家正在工业化。
This country is industrialising.
工业化带来了很多环境问题。
Industrialisation brought many environmental problems.
use: 化 = -ise, as in 现代化.

ex: 南方种水稻。
Rice is grown in the south.
农民在田里种水稻。
Farmers are planting rice in the fields.
use: Rice plant; cooked rice is 米饭, raw grain 大米.

ex: 这只是一个小小的礼物。
This is just a small gift.
一个小小的错误让他输了比赛。
One tiny mistake cost him the match.
use: Doubling makes it softer and more modest.

m: Strip off the old **hide** and make it **new**: to **innovate**; **innovation**.
ex: 技术革新很重要。
Technical innovation is very important.
公司正在革新生产方法。
The company is overhauling its production methods.
use: Formal; 技术革新 is a set phrase. Compare 创新.

ex: 孩子们的求知欲很强。
Children are very eager to learn.
他一直保持着求知的热情。
He has always kept his passion for learning.
use: 求知欲 = thirst for knowledge.

ex: 我在吃中药。
I'm taking Chinese medicine.
中药味道很苦，但是效果不错。
Chinese medicine tastes bitter but works well.
use: Measure word 服 (dose) or 副. 西药 = Western medicine.

m: A **work** that **represents** (**stands for**, **outwardly**) the artist: a **masterpiece**.
ex: 这是他的代表作。
This is his best-known work.
《红楼梦》是曹雪芹的代表作。
Dream of the Red Chamber is Cao Xueqin's masterpiece.
use: Measure word 部 or 个.

ex: 我们要从大局出发。
We must start from the big picture.
为了大局，他放弃了自己的想法。
For the greater good, he gave up his own idea.
use: 顾全大局 = put the greater good first.

ex: 这个问题很有争议。
This issue is very controversial.
这部电影引起了很大的争议。
This film caused a big controversy.
use: 有争议 = controversial; 引起争议 = cause controversy.

m: **Distant** **east**: **Liaodong**, the peninsula east of the Liao River, a name.
ex: 大连在辽东半岛上。
Dalian is on the Liaodong Peninsula.
辽东半岛的冬天很冷。
Winters on the Liaodong Peninsula are cold.
use: 辽东半岛 = Liaodong Peninsula.

ex: 请张开嘴巴，说“啊”。
Please open your mouth and say "ah".
这孩子嘴巴很甜，大家都喜欢他。
This kid talks so sweetly that everyone likes him.
use: Spoken; 嘴甜 = sweet-talking. Neutral tone: zuǐ ba.

ex: 总书记今天发表了讲话。
The general secretary gave a speech today.
他当了十年的总书记。
He was general secretary for ten years.
use: Title of a Communist Party leader.

ex: 老师对我们很亲切。
The teacher is very kind to us.
听到家乡话，我感到很亲切。
Hearing my home dialect, I felt a warm sense of closeness.
use: Warm and familiar. Compare 热情 (enthusiastic).

m: **Uncle** **uncle**: father's **younger brother**; also any man of your parents' age.
ex: 我叔叔是医生。
My uncle is a doctor.
小朋友，快谢谢叔叔！
Kids, say thank you to the man!
use: Children call adult men 叔叔. Neutral tone on the second shu.

ex: 我们的团队很棒。
Our team is great.
这个项目需要团队合作。
This project requires teamwork.
use: Work teams; sports teams are 队. 团队精神 = team spirit.

ex: 孔子是中国古代的思想家。
Confucius was an ancient Chinese thinker.
孔子说过：“学而时习之。”
Confucius said, "Learn and review often."
use: 子 here is a title of respect, "Master".

ex: 他有学士学位。
He has a bachelor's degree.
她拿到了英语学士学位。
She got a bachelor's degree in English.
use: 硕士 = master's; 博士 = doctorate.

ex: 他有几分像他爸爸。
He looks a bit like his dad.
听了这话，她心里有几分不高兴。
Hearing this, she felt a little unhappy.
use: Often 有几分 + adjective.

ex: 这个城市经历了很大的变迁。
This city has gone through great changes.
照片记录了几十年的社会变迁。
The photos record decades of social change.
use: Written; for long-term change in society or places.

ex: 他是公司的业务骨干。
He's one of the company's key staff.
这些年轻人是我们队的骨干。
These young people are the backbone of our team.
use: Key people of a group. 骨干力量 = core force.

ex: 你先冷静一下。
Calm down first.
遇到危险的时候要保持冷静。
Stay calm when you're in danger.
use: 保持冷静 = keep calm. Also a verb: 冷静一下.

ex: 这个瓶子的容量是一升。
This bottle holds one litre.
我手机的内存容量不够了。
My phone's storage is running out.
use: Also data storage.

ex: 年轻人很有活力。
Young people are full of energy.
这个城市充满了活力。
This city is full of life.
use: 充满活力 = full of energy.

m: A name that **goes through** everywhere: **generally called**.
ex: 长江以南的这片地方通称江南。
The area south of the Yangtze is generally called Jiangnan.
这种病的通称是感冒。
The common name for this illness is a cold.
use: Like 俗称 but neutral, not "folk".

ex: 我送了她一束鲜花。
I gave her a bunch of flowers.
公园里开满了鲜花。
The park is full of blooming flowers.
use: Measure word 束 (bunch) or 朵 (one).

ex: 元朝是蒙古人建立的。
The Yuan dynasty was founded by the Mongols.
马可·波罗在元朝来到中国。
Marco Polo came to China during the Yuan dynasty.
use: 1271–1368. 朝 = dynasty: 明朝, 清朝.

ex: 全会今天开幕。
The plenary session opened today.
这次全会讨论了经济问题。
This plenary session discussed economic issues.
use: Political term, often 三中全会 (Third Plenum).

m: **Extend** a **report** to the authorities: to **declare**, to **apply**.
ex: 入境要申报行李。
Luggage must be declared on entry.
他们正在申报一个科研项目。
They are applying for a research project.
use: Customs, tax and official applications.

m: A part (**部分**) that is **utterly** **big**: the **vast majority**.
ex: 绝大部分同学都来了。
The vast majority of classmates came.
他把绝大部分时间都花在了工作上。
He spends most of his time on work.
use: Also 绝大多数 (for countable people).

ex: 这首诗内涵很丰富。
This poem is rich in meaning.
她是一个很有内涵的人。
She is a person of real depth.
use: 有内涵 = cultured, deep (of people).

ex: 镜子反射了阳光。
The mirror reflected the sunlight.
这是一种条件反射。
This is a conditioned reflex.
use: For light and sound, and body reflexes.

m: The **palace hall** of **supreme** **harmony**: the **Hall of Supreme Harmony**, a name.
ex: 太和殿是故宫最大的宫殿。
The Hall of Supreme Harmony is the largest hall in the Forbidden City.
我们在太和殿前拍了照。
We took photos in front of the Hall of Supreme Harmony.
use: In the Forbidden City, Beijing.

m: A **sweet** **spring**: a sweet spring; **Ganquan**, a county name.
ex: 山里有一眼甘泉。
There is a sweet spring in the mountains.
甘泉县在陕西北部。
Ganquan County is in northern Shaanxi.
use: Measure word for springs: 眼.

m: **That** **tip**: an old spelling of 那么, **then**, **so**.
ex: 那末，我们开始吧。
Well then, let's begin.
如果你不去，那末我也不去了。
If you're not going, then I won't go either.
use: Old variant; today write 那么.

ex: 他分不清是非。
He can't tell right from wrong.
她不喜欢说别人的是非。
She doesn't like to gossip about others.
use: 惹是非 = stir up trouble.

ex: 西安是陕西省的省会。
Xi'an is the capital of Shaanxi Province.
陕西省有很多历史古迹。
Shaanxi Province has many historic sites.
use: Not 山西 (Shānxī), the province next door.

ex: 他家饲养了很多鸡。
His family raises lots of chickens.
这些熊猫由专人饲养。
These pandas are looked after by special keepers.
use: Formal; speech uses 养.

ex: 他信奉佛教。
He believes in Buddhism.
我一直信奉“诚实第一”。
I have always believed in "honesty first".
use: Religions and principles. Formal; 信 alone is spoken.

ex: 厨房要保持清洁。
The kitchen must be kept clean.
清洁工每天早上打扫街道。
The street cleaners sweep the streets every morning.
use: Formal; speech uses 干净. 清洁工 = cleaner.

m: The **field** where the **long** **river** **flows**: the **Yangtze River basin**.
ex: 长江流域人口很多。
The Yangtze basin is densely populated.
长江流域夏天经常下大雨。
The Yangtze basin often has heavy rain in summer.
use: 流域 = river basin; also 黄河流域.

ex: 除非你去，我才去。
I'll go only if you go.
除非下大雨，否则比赛照常进行。
Unless it rains heavily, the match will go ahead.
use: Patterns: 除非…才…; 除非…否则/不然….

m: Hold the **linchpin** of those **below**: to **administer**, to **have under it**.
ex: 这个市下辖五个区。
This city has five districts under it.
省政府下辖很多部门。
The provincial government oversees many departments.
use: Formal, for administrative areas.

ex: 门口站着一位妇人。
A woman was standing at the door.
那个妇人抱着孩子上了车。
The woman got on the bus holding a child.
use: Literary or old-fashioned; today 妇女 or 女人.

ex: 我们要记住祖宗的话。
We should remember the words of our ancestors.
这是祖宗留下来的房子。
This house was left to us by our ancestors.
use: Spoken exclamation: 小祖宗 (little rascal). Neutral tone: zǔ zong.

ex: 他的诗对后世影响很大。
His poetry greatly influenced later generations.
这些故事一直流传到后世。
These stories were handed down to later ages.
use: Written; speech: 后人.

m: A **younger brother** under the same **teacher**: a **junior fellow student**.
ex: 他是我的师弟。
He's my junior fellow student.
师兄带着师弟一起练功。
The senior student practised kung fu with his junior.
use: Male; female is 师妹. Senior: 师兄.

ex: 这张照片很模糊。
This photo is blurry.
我对那天的事只有模糊的印象。
I have only a vague memory of that day.
use: Opposite: 清楚, 清晰. Neutral tone: mó hu.

ex: 现在比分是多少？
What's the score now?
最后比分是二比一。
The final score was two to one.
use: Read scores with 比: 三比二 (3–2).

ex: 这是很古老的地层。
This is a very old stratum.
科学家在地层里发现了化石。
Scientists found fossils in the rock layers.
use: Geology term.

ex: 我喜欢蓝色。
I like blue.
她穿着一件蓝色的裙子。
She is wearing a blue dress.
use: Before a noun: 蓝色的 or just 蓝.

ex: 我是辽宁人。
I'm from Liaoning.
辽宁的冬天很长。
Winters in Liaoning are long.
use: Capital: 沈阳. Short name: 辽.

ex: 给您带来不便，很抱歉。
Sorry for the inconvenience.
他腿受伤了，行动不便。
He hurt his leg and has trouble getting around.
use: Formal; speech uses 不方便.

ex: 她很注意保健。
She pays great attention to keeping healthy.
老人常常买保健品。
Old people often buy health supplements.
use: 保健品 = health supplements.

ex: 请尽可能早点来。
Please come as early as possible.
我会尽可能帮你。
I'll help you as much as I can.
use: Before verbs or adjectives. Note: 尽 is jǐn here.

ex: 屏幕上的图像很清楚。
The image on the screen is very clear.
这个软件可以处理图像。
This software can process images.
use: Technical; 图片 is a picture or photo.

ex: 他在水下待了两分钟。
He stayed underwater for two minutes.
水下的世界非常美丽。
The underwater world is very beautiful.
use: Often before nouns: 水下摄影.

ex: 两个城市相距一百公里。
The two cities are 100 km apart.
我们两家相距不远。
Our two homes aren't far apart.
use: Formal; followed by a distance.

ex: 他转动了一下门把手。
He turned the door handle.
地球一直在转动。
The earth is always turning.
use: Physical turning; compare 转身 (turn around).

ex: 我们预定下午三点出发。
We're scheduled to leave at 3 p.m.
会议在预定时间开始了。
The meeting began at the scheduled time.
use: For booking rooms, 预订 is more common.

ex: 我很同情他。
I feel very sorry for him.
她的故事引起了大家的同情。
Her story won everyone's sympathy.
use: 同情心 = compassion.

ex: 太阳是一个天体。
The sun is a celestial body.
科学家用望远镜观察天体。
Scientists observe celestial bodies with telescopes.
use: Also "nude" in 天体浴场 (nudist beach).

m: The **test** in the **palace hall**: the **palace examination**.
ex: 他参加了殿试。
He took the palace examination.
殿试的第一名叫状元。
The top scorer in the palace exam was called zhuangyuan.
use: Historical; the final imperial exam.

ex: 中国人很重视礼仪。
Chinese people value etiquette.
我们公司有专门的礼仪培训。
Our company has special etiquette training.
use: 礼仪小姐 = hostess at ceremonies.

m: **Following** your **hand**: **as you go**, on the way.
ex: 出门请随手关灯。
Please turn off the lights as you leave.
他随手拿了一本书看起来。
He picked up a book at random and started reading.
use: Before verbs: 随手关门, 随手扔.

ex: 这里云集了很多名人。
Many celebrities gathered here.
每年春节，车站人群云集。
Every Spring Festival, crowds pack the stations.
use: Literary; for crowds and talent.

m: A **signboard** gate on a **lane**: a **memorial arch**.
ex: 村口有一座牌坊。
There's a memorial arch at the village entrance.
这座石牌坊有三百年历史了。
This stone arch is three hundred years old.
use: Measure word 座.

ex: 她独自去了北京。
She went to Beijing alone.
他一个人独自住在山里。
He lives all by himself in the mountains.
use: Before verbs. Compare 单独.

ex: 太阳慢慢落下了。
The sun slowly set.
树上的苹果落下来了。
The apple fell from the tree.
use: Read là xia, it means to leave something behind or fall behind.

ex: 人们从四方赶来。
People rushed in from all directions.
桌子上放着一个四方的盒子。
There's a square box on the table.
use: 四面八方 = all directions.

ex: 当时你在场吗？
Were you there at the time?
在场的人都笑了。
Everyone present laughed.
use: 在场的人 = those present.

ex: 这座山形状很奇特。
This mountain has an unusual shape.
他想出了一个奇特的办法。
He came up with a peculiar method.
use: More positive than 奇怪 (odd).

m: **Receive** one **linked** to the next: **in a row**.
ex: 他接连打了三个电话。
He made three calls in a row.
这几天接连下雨。
It has rained for several days running.
use: Before verbs. Close to 连续.

ex: 这片水域很深。
These waters are very deep.
船只不能进入这片水域。
Ships may not enter these waters.
use: Formal; maps and news.

ex: 谢谢你的帮助！
Thanks for your help!
他连说了三声谢谢。
He said thank you three times.
use: Reply: 不客气 or 不用谢. Neutral tone on the second xie.

ex: 青春只有一次。
You're only young once.
他把青春献给了这片土地。
He gave his youth to this land.
use: 青春期 = adolescence.

m: The **people**'s **daily** **report**: the **People's Daily**, a newspaper name.
ex: 我爷爷每天看人民日报。
My grandpa reads the People's Daily every day.
这篇文章发表在《人民日报》上。
This article was published in the People's Daily.
use: Write with 《》 in text.

m: Using that as the point, to the **east**: **east of**.
ex: 山以东是大海。
East of the mountains is the sea.
北京以东一百公里有个城市。
There's a city 100 km east of Beijing.
use: After a place: X以东. Also 以西, 以南, 以北.

ex: 每个词都有对应的英文。
Every word has an English equivalent.
这两个数字是一一对应的。
These two numbers correspond one to one.
use: 跟…对应, 一一对应.

m: **Weigh** the right word and **call** someone: to **address**; a **form of address**.
ex: 我该怎么称呼您？
How should I address you?
在中国，称呼长辈要用敬语。
In China you use polite terms to address elders.
use: Common polite question. Neutral tone: chēng hu.

ex: 他讲了一个笑话。
He told a joke.
你别笑话我，我是第一次做。
Don't laugh at me, it's my first time.
use: 讲/说笑话 = tell a joke. Neutral tone: xiào hua.

ex: 我只吃鸡蛋的蛋白。
I only eat the egg white.
牛奶里有很多蛋白。
Milk has lots of protein.
use: 蛋白质 is the full word for protein.

ex: 这家店卖电器。
This shop sells electrical appliances.
出门前要关掉所有电器。
Switch off all appliances before going out.
use: 家用电器 = household appliances.

ex: 我想喝一瓶汽水。
I'd like a bottle of soda.
夏天喝冰汽水特别舒服。
Cold soda is really nice in summer.
use: Measure word 瓶. 可乐 = cola.

ex: 他原先是老师。
He was originally a teacher.
这里原先是一片农田。
This was originally farmland.
use: Spoken; close to 原来 and 以前.

ex: 手机接收不到信号。
The phone can't get a signal.
这所学校今年接收了很多新学生。
This school took in many new students this year.
use: Signals, data, people, property.

ex: 等到明天再说吧。
Let's wait until tomorrow to discuss it.
等到我们赶到，电影已经开始了。
By the time we arrived, the film had started.
use: 等到…的时候 = by the time….

m: A **law** on how to **form** and **weave** an organisation: an **organic law**.
ex: 这部组织法很重要。
This organic law is important.
他在研究地方政府组织法。
He is studying the organic law of local government.
use: Legal term.

ex: 请回答下列问题。
Please answer the following questions.
下列人员请到前台报到。
The following people please report to the front desk.
use: Written; exam instructions. Speech: 下面的.

ex: 他们的市场份额在增加。
Their market share is growing.
每个人的份额都一样。
Everyone's share is the same.
use: 市场份额 = market share.

ex: 他感到一阵剧烈的头疼。
He felt a sharp headache.
饭后不要做剧烈运动。
Don't do strenuous exercise after eating.
use: With 运动, 疼痛, 变化.

ex: 他现在不在线。
He's not online now.
我每天在线学习一个小时。
I study online for an hour every day.
use: 在线支付 = online payment. Opposite: 离线.

ex: 我住在楼上。
I live upstairs.
楼上的邻居晚上很吵。
The upstairs neighbours are noisy at night.
use: Opposite 楼下. Online slang: the previous poster.

ex: 节日里到处是欢乐的笑声。
During the festival there's happy laughter everywhere.
孩子们给家里带来了很多欢乐。
The children brought a lot of joy to the family.
use: Written; for scenes and atmospheres. 快乐 is for feelings.

ex: 他是我们的科长。
He is our section chief.
科长让我把文件送过去。
The section chief asked me to deliver the documents.
use: Office rank below 处长.

m: **Place** and **set** things right: to **deal with**, to **dispose of**.
ex: 这件事你来处置吧。
You deal with this matter.
这些旧电池要正确处置。
These old batteries must be disposed of properly.
use: Formal; note 处 is chǔ. Compare 处理.

ex: 谁知他没来。
Who'd have thought he didn't come.
我以为天会晴，谁知下起了大雨。
I thought it would be sunny, but unexpectedly it poured.
use: Starts a clause with a surprise. Also 谁知道.

ex: 我想说两句。
I'd like to say a few words.
他们吵了两句就不说话了。
They had a few words and then stopped talking.
use: Not exactly two: "a few". 说两句 = say a few words.

m: **Life**-deep **fear**: to be **afraid that**, for fear that.
ex: 他走得很慢，生怕摔倒。
He walked slowly for fear of falling.
她一直看着孩子，生怕他走丢了。
She kept an eye on the child, afraid he'd get lost.
use: Followed by a clause; stronger than 怕.

ex: 我们在门洞里躲雨。
We sheltered from the rain in the archway.
穿过门洞就是一个小院子。
Through the gateway there is a small courtyard.
use: Common in old Beijing houses.

ex: 这条马路很宽阔。
This road is very wide.
他站在宽阔的广场上。
He stood on the broad square.
use: Written; speech uses 宽. Also 心胸宽阔 (broad-minded).

ex: 祖国山河多美啊！
How beautiful our country's land is!
他们为保卫山河献出了生命。
They gave their lives to defend their homeland.
use: Literary, patriotic tone.

m: The **new** **China** (**magnificent**) **net**: **Xinhua Net**, a news site name.
ex: 我在新华网上看到了这条新闻。
I saw this news on Xinhua Net.
新华网报道了这次会议。
Xinhua Net reported on the meeting.
use: Site of the 新华社 news agency.

ex: 这首歌曲很好听。
This song sounds lovely.
她唱了一首中文歌曲。
She sang a Chinese song.
use: Measure word 首. More formal than 歌.

m: Your **life** laid **flat**: one's **life story**; in one's life.
ex: 他介绍了作家的生平。
He gave a short account of the writer's life.
这是我生平第一次坐飞机。
This is the first flight of my life.
use: 生平简介 = short biography.

ex: 安全永远放在首位。
Safety always comes first.
他的成绩排在全班首位。
His results are first in the class.
use: Often 放在首位 = put first.

ex: 他去中亚旅行了。
He travelled to Central Asia.
丝绸之路经过中亚很多国家。
The Silk Road passes through many Central Asian countries.
use: 亚 = Asia, as in 东亚, 南亚.

ex: 这所大学今年招收三千人。
This university is taking in three thousand students this year.
公司正在招收新员工。
The company is recruiting new staff.
use: Students, staff, apprentices. Compare 招聘 (hire).

m: Hold in your **palm** and **take care of**: to **be in charge of**.
ex: 家里的钱由妈妈掌管。
Mum is in charge of the family's money.
他掌管着公司的财务。
He controls the company's finances.
use: Implies real power over something.

m: **Straight** under, like a **servant** to the capital: **Zhili**, an old province name.
ex: 直隶是明清时的一个省。
Zhili was a province in Ming and Qing times.
清朝的直隶包括今天的河北。
Qing-dynasty Zhili included today's Hebei.
use: Historical; roughly today's Hebei.

ex: 老师着重讲了这个问题。
The teacher stressed this question.
这次会议着重讨论了安全问题。
This meeting focused on safety issues.
use: Formal; before verbs. Note: 着 is zhuó here.

ex: 我喜欢吃麻婆豆腐。
I like mapo tofu.
妈妈在市场买了一块豆腐。
Mum bought a block of tofu at the market.
use: Measure word 块. Slang 吃豆腐 = take liberties with someone.

m: The **southern** **great mountain**: **Nanyue**, Mount Heng, a name.
ex: 南岳衡山在湖南。
Nanyue, Mount Heng, is in Hunan.
很多人来南岳烧香。
Many people come to Nanyue to burn incense.
use: One of China's Five Great Mountains (五岳).

ex: 这里是一片沼泽。
This is a swamp.
千万别走进沼泽里。
Whatever you do, don't walk into the swamp.
use: Measure word 片.

ex: 这块石头已经有一万年了。
This rock is ten thousand years old.
他们希望友谊万年长青。
They hope their friendship lasts forever.
use: Also a county in Jiangxi.

ex: 此间天气很好。
The weather here is fine.
据此间媒体报道，会议已经结束。
According to the local media, the meeting is over.
use: Literary; news style.

ex: 他是美国华侨。
He is an overseas Chinese living in the US.
很多华侨回国过春节。
Many overseas Chinese return home for Spring Festival.
use: 华人 is broader: ethnic Chinese of any nationality.

ex: 房间里装有空调。
The room has air conditioning.
这个箱子里装有很多书。
This box contains many books.
use: Formal; speech: 有 or 装了.

ex: 广场上有人集会。
People are holding a rally in the square.
他们每周在这里集会一次。
They gather here once a week.
use: Usually public or political gatherings.

ex: 这里环境优美。
The surroundings here are lovely.
她的舞蹈动作非常优美。
Her dance movements are very graceful.
use: For scenery, music, movement, writing.

ex: 东风吹来，春天到了。
The east wind blows; spring is here.
万事俱备，只欠东风。
Everything's ready except the last crucial piece.
use: The idiom comes from the Three Kingdoms story.

ex: 他在大学学过毛泽东思想。
He studied Mao Zedong Thought at university.
这本书介绍了毛泽东思想。
This book introduces Mao Zedong Thought.
use: Political term.

m: The **warm** **band** of the earth: the **temperate zone**.
ex: 中国大部分在温带。
Most of China is in the temperate zone.
温带地区四季分明。
Temperate regions have four distinct seasons.
use: Also 热带 (tropics), 寒带 (frigid zone).

ex: 他的话激励了我。
His words inspired me.
公司用奖金激励员工。
The company motivates staff with bonuses.
use: Stronger than 鼓励.

ex: 三天以内给你答复。
I'll reply within three days.
一百块钱以内的礼物就可以了。
A gift under a hundred yuan is fine.
use: After a number or place: 一公里以内.

ex: 山谷里有一条小河。
There's a stream in the valley.
他大喊一声，山谷里传来了回声。
He shouted, and an echo came back from the valley.
我们终于到了山顶。
We finally reached the top of the mountain.
站在山顶上可以看见整个城市。
From the summit you can see the whole city.
use: 爬到山顶 = climb to the top.

ex: 这个消息让大家很震惊。
The news shocked everyone.
这次事故震惊了全国。
The accident shocked the whole country.
use: Stronger than 吃惊.

ex: 这里的地理位置很优越。
This place has a superb location.
他有一种优越感。
He has a sense of superiority.
use: 优越感 = superiority complex. 优越条件 = favourable conditions.

m: A **jewel** and a **cowrie** shell: a **treasure**; **baby**, darling.
ex: 宝贝，快来吃饭！
Sweetie, come and eat!
这些老照片是爷爷的宝贝。
These old photos are grandpa's treasures.
use: A term of endearment for children and lovers.

m: **Piece** your whole **life** into it: **with all one's might**.
ex: 他拼命地跑。
He ran as fast as he could.
为了买房子，他们拼命工作。
They're working like crazy to buy a flat.
use: Spoken; also 拼了命.

ex: 我爸爸去年退休了。
My dad retired last year.
退休以后，她每天去公园跳舞。
Since retiring, she dances in the park every day.
use: 退休金 = pension.

m: An **iron** **mineral deposit**: **iron ore**, an iron mine.
ex: 这里有个大铁矿。
There's a big iron mine here.
中国从国外进口很多铁矿。
China imports a lot of iron ore.
use: Also 铁矿石 (iron ore).

ex: 他的户口在上海。
His household registration is in Shanghai.
没有北京户口，很多事都不方便。
Without a Beijing hukou, lots of things are inconvenient.
use: China's residence permit system. 户口本 = hukou booklet.

ex: 你得赔偿我的损失。
You have to compensate me for my loss.
保险公司赔偿了他十万块。
The insurance company paid him 100,000 yuan in compensation.
use: Spoken: 赔.

ex: 虽说很累，但是很开心。
Though tired, I'm very happy.
虽说他年纪不大，可是经验很丰富。
Though he's young, he's very experienced.
use: Spoken version of 虽然. Pairs with 但是 or 可是.

ex: 我不曾见过他。
I have never met him.
这种事以前不曾发生过。
This kind of thing has never happened before.
use: Written; spoken: 没有…过. Opposite: 曾经.

ex: 这取决于你。
That depends on you.
成绩好坏主要取决于努力。
Good or bad results mostly depend on effort.
use: Almost always 取决于.

m: A **step** on the **ground** you have reached: a **stage**, a **point** (often bad).
ex: 事情怎么会到这个地步？
How did things get to this point?
他累到了站都站不稳的地步。
He was so tired he could barely stand.
use: Usually a bad state: 到了…的地步.

ex: 她是一个公司白领。
She is an office worker.
很多白领中午在公司附近吃饭。
Many office workers eat lunch near the office.
use: Opposite: 蓝领 (blue-collar).

m: The **chief** of those who **supervise** **matters**: the **chairman** of the board.
ex: 他是公司的董事长。
He is the chairman of the company.
董事长明天要来我们部门。
The chairman is coming to our department tomorrow.
use: Highest boss; 总经理 = general manager.

ex: 手机给我推送了一条新闻。
My phone pushed a news story to me.
你可以关掉这个应用的推送。
You can turn off this app's notifications.
use: Tech word; 消息推送 = push notifications.

ex: 死者是一名男子。
The deceased was a man.
警察正在调查死者的身份。
The police are investigating the identity of the deceased.
use: Formal; news and police reports.

ex: 大家都感动不已。
Everyone was deeply moved.
听到这个消息，他兴奋不已。
Hearing the news, he was thrilled beyond words.
use: After a verb or adjective of feeling: 感叹不已.

ex: 他的房间很整齐。
His room is very tidy.
学生们排着整齐的队伍。
The students lined up in neat rows.
use: Opposite: 乱. Also 整整齐齐.

ex: 风雨很猛烈。
The storm is fierce.
敌人发动了猛烈的进攻。
The enemy launched a fierce attack.
use: For attacks, winds, fire, criticism.

ex: 他们在山上造林。
They're planting forests on the hills.
植树造林可以保护环境。
Planting trees helps protect the environment.
use: 植树造林 is a set phrase.

ex: 他爷爷参加过国民革命军。
His grandpa served in the National Revolutionary Army.
国民革命军在一九二六年开始北伐。
The National Revolutionary Army began the Northern Expedition in 1926.
use: The Kuomintang's army.

ex: 他在听无线电。
He's listening to the radio.
船上的无线电坏了。
The radio on the ship is broken.
use: Old-fashioned for a radio set; now 收音机. Also radio technology.

ex: 别着急，慢慢来。
Don't worry, take your time.
他找不到钥匙，非常着急。
He couldn't find his keys and was very anxious.
use: Note: 着 is zháo here. 为…着急 = worry about.

ex: 这里有古代城市的遗迹。
Here are the remains of an ancient city.
我们参观了很多历史遗迹。
We visited many historical sites.
use: Compare 遗址 (site of ruins).

ex: 这幅画被拍卖了。
This painting was auctioned.
他在拍卖会上买了一个花瓶。
He bought a vase at an auction.
use: 拍卖会 = auction.

ex: 我们要整合资源。
We need to pool our resources.
公司把两个部门整合在一起。
The company merged the two departments.
use: Business and tech term.

ex: 我最近睡眠不好。
I haven't been sleeping well lately.
每天要保证八个小时的睡眠。
Make sure you get eight hours of sleep a day.
use: Noun; to sleep is 睡觉. 睡眠质量 = sleep quality.

m: **All**, **kudzu**, **bright**: **Zhuge Liang**, a famous strategist, a name.
ex: 诸葛亮非常聪明。
Zhuge Liang was very clever.
三个臭皮匠，顶个诸葛亮。
Three ordinary people together are as wise as Zhuge Liang.
use: Byword for a wise person. 诸葛 is a two-character surname.

ex: 书在书架的上层。
The books are on the top shelf.
他出身于上层社会。
He comes from upper-class society.
use: 上层社会 = high society.

ex: 不要强迫孩子学习。
Don't force children to study.
没有人强迫你，是你自己愿意的。
No one forced you; you wanted to.
use: Note: 强 is qiǎng here. 强迫症 = OCD.

m: **Call** your **self**: to **call oneself**, to **claim to be**.
ex: 他自称是医生。
He claims to be a doctor.
那个自称是警察的人走了。
The man who claimed to be a policeman has left.
use: Often suggests doubt.

ex: 妈妈教会了我做饭。
Mum taught me to cook.
这本书教会了我很多道理。
This book taught me many lessons.
use: Note: jiào huì (church) is a different word with the same characters.

m: Those in the **category** of the **home**: **family members**.
ex: 病人家属请在外面等。
Patients' family members please wait outside.
公司邀请员工和家属一起去旅游。
The company invited staff and their families on a trip.
use: Formal; hospitals and offices.

ex: 这里物价很高。
Prices are high here.
最近物价涨得太快了。
Prices have risen too fast lately.
use: General price level; one item's price is 价格.

ex: 我老公在做饭。
My husband is cooking.
她和老公一起去看电影了。
She went to the cinema with her husband.
use: Spoken and affectionate. Wife: 老婆.

ex: 我喜欢看三国的故事。
I like stories about the Three Kingdoms.
三国时期有很多有名的人物。
The Three Kingdoms period had many famous figures.
use: 《三国演义》 = Romance of the Three Kingdoms.

ex: 飞机在城市上空飞过。
A plane flew over the city.
北京上空出现了一道彩虹。
A rainbow appeared in the sky over Beijing.
use: After a place: X上空.

ex: 她德才兼备。
She has both integrity and ability.
这部电影娱乐和教育兼备。
This film is both entertaining and educational.
use: Written; A和B兼备. 德才兼备 is a set phrase.

ex: 庭长宣布开庭。
The presiding judge declared the court in session.
她当了十年法院庭长。
She was a presiding judge for ten years.
use: Legal term.

m: The **old** and **big** one: the **eldest child**; the **boss**.
ex: 我是家里的老大。
I'm the eldest in my family.
他是这个公司的老大。
He's the big boss of this company.
use: Spoken. Also adverb in 老大不小 (no longer young).

m: A **front** **line** where all **gather** as **one** to **fight**: a **united front**.
ex: 他们组成了统一战线。
They formed a united front.
统一战线在历史上很重要。
The united front was important in history.
use: Political term; short form 统战.

ex: 他在行政公署上班。
He works at the administrative office.
行政公署设在市中心。
The administrative office is in the city centre.
use: Old Chinese admin unit; short form 行署.

ex: 这个市有六个市辖区。
This city has six districts.
他住在市辖区，不住在县里。
He lives in a city district, not in a county.
use: Chinese admin term.

ex: 地上有一个影子。
There's a shadow on the ground.
我找了半天，连他的影子都没看见。
I looked for ages and didn't see a trace of him.
use: 连影子都没有 = not a trace.

ex: 我给你发了私信。
I sent you a private message.
有事可以私信我。
DM me if you need anything.
use: Social media word; also a verb.

ex: 两国讨论了防务合作。
The two countries discussed defence cooperation.
他是负责防务的官员。
He is the official in charge of defence.
use: Formal; news and politics.

ex: 这些陶器很古老。
This pottery is very old.
博物馆里有很多古代陶器。
The museum has a lot of ancient pottery.
use: Compare 瓷器 (porcelain).

m: A **body** (**machine** and **pass**) that **rules** **itself**: an **autonomous government body**.
ex: 自治机关由当地人组成。
The autonomous body is made up of local people.
民族自治地方设立自治机关。
Ethnic autonomous areas set up their own governing bodies.
use: Legal and political term.

ex: 他买了几个莲蓬。
He bought a few lotus seed heads.
夏天，湖里长满了莲蓬。
In summer the lake is full of lotus seed heads.
use: You eat the seeds, 莲子. Also a shower head: 莲蓬头.

ex: 这是一起刑事案件。
This is a criminal case.
他要承担刑事责任。
He will be held criminally liable.
use: Before nouns. Opposite: 民事 (civil).

ex: 今天运气真好！
What luck today!
这次考试有一半靠运气。
Half of this exam was down to luck.
use: 运气好/不好. Neutral tone: yùn qi.

m: **Hemp** **city**: **Macheng**, a city in Hubei, a name.
ex: 麻城在湖北东北部。
Macheng is in northeast Hubei.
我的朋友是麻城人。
My friend is from Macheng.
我会说一点儿中文。
I can speak a little Chinese.
你能便宜一点儿吗？
Can you make it a bit cheaper?
use: After adjectives: 快一点儿. Not before adjectives: use 有点儿.

m: The **head** minister: **prime minister** (of the UK, Japan etc).
ex: 英国首相访问了中国。
The British prime minister visited China.
日本首相今天发表了讲话。
Japan's prime minister made a speech today.
use: For China's premier use 总理.

ex: 这种花叫作牡丹。
This flower is called the peony.
我们把这种做法叫作“双赢”。
We call this approach a "win-win".
use: Also written 叫做. Pattern: 把A叫作B.

ex: 一直往前走。
Go straight ahead.
从这儿往前走两百米就到了。
Walk two hundred metres ahead from here and you're there.
use: Spoken; 往 + direction: 往前走, 往左拐.

ex: 他考上了清华。
He got into Tsinghua.
清华大学在北京西北部。
Tsinghua University is in northwest Beijing.
use: Short for 清华大学.

ex: 看电影要吃爆米花。
Popcorn is a must at the cinema.
我买了一大桶爆米花。
I bought a big tub of popcorn.
use: Measure word 桶 (tub) or 包.

ex: 孩子睡着了。
The child has fallen asleep.
我昨晚很晚才睡着。
I didn't fall asleep until very late last night.
use: Note: zháo. 睡不着 = can't get to sleep.

ex: 手机和电脑可以同步。
The phone and computer can sync.
这部电影全球同步上映。
This film opens worldwide at the same time.
use: Tech: 同步数据 (sync data).

ex: 他改装了自己的车。
He modified his car.
这个仓库被改装成了咖啡馆。
This warehouse was converted into a café.
use: 改装成 = convert into.
